@default_cost: 39
@description:
 [Vocational] An athlete is devoted to the pursuit of excellence in physical
 prowess. Athletes often obtain a level of fame comparable to adventurers, and
 they lead lives that are considerably less dangerous. An athlete can excel at
 almost any physical game or sport, although rarely does he compete in more
 than a few related activities. Time to Acquire: 36 months. Starting Money:
 normal + d10 (open-ended).
